entities.summary: Jack Arkinstall was an Australian tennis player. He was a semi-finalist at the 1962 U.S. Pro Tennis Championships. He was active on the ILTF World Circuit from 1946 to 1958, then on the Pro Tennis Tour until 1962, and won 60 amateur and professional singles titles.
